bagPolicy.summary: Only small handbags 6 x 9 inches or smaller, or clear bags, are allowed inside. All bags are searched at entry, and there is no bag or coat check.
allowed: Small handbags 6 x 9 inches or smaller
prohibited: Bags larger than 6 x 9 inches that are not clear
bagPolicy.quote: We are currently allowing only Small Handbags (6″ x 9″ or smaller) or Clear Bags into the venue.

parking.summary: There is no parking at the venue, and street parking nearby can be limited at peak hours. Limited parking is available at Zenanli Parking, a public lot at 344 14th Street about five minutes away, or you can take public transit, a taxi or rideshare.
parking.quote: There is no parking available onsite.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Brick & Mortar Music Hall. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The bar takes cash, Amex, Visa, Mastercard and Apple Pay for drinks.
concessions.quote: For beverage purchases inside at our bar, we accept Cash, Amex, Visa, Mastercard and ApplePay.

accessibility.summary: Send ADA requests at least a day or two before the show by emailing info@brickandmortarmusic.org or calling (415) 817-1479.
accessibility.quote: ADA requests should be sent at least a day or two before the show to info@brickandmortarmusic.org or (415) 817-1479.

reEntry.summary: Brick & Mortar Music Hall hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: There is no box office at the venue, so buy tickets online in advance. If a show hasn't sold out, tickets are sold at the door first come, first served. Everyone needs their own ticket, bring ID, and All Ages shows are for ages 6 and up.
ticketPickup.quote: We do not have a Box Office onsite.

gates.summary: Brick & Mortar Music Hall hasn't published entrance and door details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
